instruction: Help me download the Oxford University logo in BMP format through GIMP's interface, without needing to use an external web browser.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible as GIMP is not equipped with web browsing or download functionality. It serves solely as an image editing application.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP is an image editing application without web browsing or download capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically appropriate for impossible tasks
Complete coverage - there is no valid state to verify since the task cannot be completed
Logic is correct - impossible tasks should use the infeasible() evaluator placeholder
